complexity.fact: Linear dense search over count with a stored32-bit hash filter and exact length/byte comparison. Block use count<=256; function use count<=128. It is not a hash-table lookup.

Already uses a2048-slot open-address table with exact length/byte matching and linear probing. Expected few probes is not an all-input bound; worst case remains2048 probes. It reuses dense IDs for definitions and uses, including replay.

Still calls the linear lookup_identifier over the per-function block map. Discovering B distinct labels incurs the usual sum0..B-1 search count, and later references/definitions scan that same bounded map. A separate exact-byte block index is a possible later owner change, not part of this patch.
